description.value: Casa Del Pane is a family-owned Italian bakery and deli in Port Moody with over 30 years of tradition, producing bread, pastries, donuts, and custom cakes from heritage recipes. The shop also serves freshly made pizza and panini daily, making it a genuine stop for a hot meal on the road. Its warm, community-oriented atmosphere and broad savoury-and-sweet menu offer touring cyclists a meaningful resupply and rest point.
